_meta.description: Index of all reference materials and integration sources for com.ubnt.unifi

sources.summary: Primary UniFi controller client. Handles session-cookie auth (legacy + UniFi OS), CSRF, WebSocket event stream via EventEmitter2. Auto-detects UniFi OS (_unifios flag) and switches between /api/login and /api/auth/login and /proxy/network prefix. Used directly in library/apiclient.js.
sources.homey_usage: library/apiclient.js — new Unifi.Controller({host, port, sslverify, site})

sources.summary: Official Ubiquiti UniFi Network REST API OpenAPI spec. Covers /v1/ endpoints: sites, devices, clients, networks, WiFi broadcasts, hotspot vouchers, firewall zones/policies, ACL rules, DNS policies, traffic matching lists. Auth: Bearer API Key.
Quick-reference list of all /v1/ REST endpoints with HTTP methods. Useful for finding the right endpoint for a given operation.
High-level summary of the official UniFi Network API: auth model (Bearer API key), pagination, filtering, error model, primary domains.
JSON Schema for UniFi Network API request/response objects. Use for runtime validation and type generation.
Full prose documentation of the UniFi Network API including authentication flow, rate limits, and error handling patterns.
Detailed notes on controller base paths, auth endpoints, UniFi OS vs legacy differences, CSRF handling, site scoping, and API-key setup.
Matrix of supported UniFi device classes (UAP, USW, UDM/UXG, clients) with relevant metrics, capabilities, and Homey driver mappings.
Complete catalogue of implemented and planned Homey flow cards (triggers, conditions, actions) with UniFi event/API sources.
WebSocket endpoints, reconnect backoff spec, ping/pong heartbeat, safe polling intervals, firmware version caveats.
UniFi Network 7.x/8.x/9.x compatibility notes, UniFi OS version differences, controller deployment type detection.
